name: Logout functionality works correctly
fullName: Zen Portal Login and Logout: Logout functionality works correctly

steps.name: Given I am logged in to the Zen Portal
Log in to the Zen Portal with valid credentials
When I click the logout button
Click the Log out menu item
Then I should be redirected back to the login page
Verify the browser returned to the login page
